summary: An Abu Dhabi clinic with around a dozen listed doctors, Arabic and English service and WhatsApp booking is a strength, but three different phone numbers and repeated doctor cards appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: Three different phone numbers appear (+97125031111, 97125031100 and 971501250404) across the call button, offers and doctor cards.
findings.cost: Patients may call or message the wrong line and give up.

findings.problem: The Services menu and the cosmetic dentistry and orthodontics parent items appear to link to #, and some read more links appear to use malformed web addresses.
findings.cost: Visitors cannot reach your service pages from the menu.
findings.fix: Working service pages and correct links.

findings.problem: Doctor cards appear repeated two or three times, some doctor names appear garbled, and the doctor button text appears to show a leftover image file name.
findings.cost: Repeated cards, garbled names and file names look unprofessional in a medical brand.
findings.fix: One clean card per doctor with correct names.

findings.problem: A New Year offers section appears with no end date, no testimonials or before and after cases appear, and the booking form appears to show no clear submit button.
findings.cost: Stale offers and missing proof lose trust, and a form without a button loses bookings.
findings.fix: Dated offers, real reviews and a working booking form.

redesign: Clean doctor cards, dated offers and a working booking form.
